record.paper_title: Some Open Questions on Anti-de Sitter Geometry
record.original_question: Is every globally hyperbolic maximal compact anti-de Sitter manifold a deformation of a GH-standard anti-de Sitter manifold, namely one obtained from a quotient Γ\Ω with Γ contained in SO(1,p) × SO(1,q) ⊂ SO(2,n) for some p + q = n?

evidence.quote: Question 5.2. Is every GHMC AdS manifold a deformation of a GH-standard AdS manifold?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let n ≥ 1 and consider the pseudo-Riemannian symmetric space AdS_{n+1}, the (n+1)-dimensional anti-de Sitter space, realized as a connected component of a quadric in ℝ^{2,n} with isometry group containing SO(2,n). A Lorentzian manifold M is called globally hyperbolic maximal compact (GHMC) AdS if it is a maximal globally hyperbolic anti-de Sitter manifold admitting a Cauchy hypersurface that is closed (compact without boundary).

Call a GHMC AdS manifold GH-standard if it is isometric to a quotient Γ\Ω, where Ω ⊂ AdS_{n+1} is an open domain and Γ is a discrete subgroup of SO(2,n) contained in a subgroup of the form SO(1,p) × SO(1,q) ⊂ SO(2,n) for some non-negative integers p, q with p + q = n, acting properly discontinuously and freely on Ω with compact Cauchy quotient.

Question: Is every GHMC anti-de Sitter manifold a continuous deformation (i.e., lies in the same connected component of the deformation space of GHMC AdS structures) of a GH-standard AdS manifold?
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work (2017–2025) on GHMC anti-de Sitter manifolds focuses on deformation spaces, moduli, pressure metrics, wild structures, and degeneration along rays, but no source found explicitly resolves whether every GHMC AdS manifold is a deformation of a GH-standard one in the sense of containment in SO(1,p)×SO(1,q). The question's status appears unresolved in the literature surveyed.

status_evidence.title: Riemannian metrics on the moduli space of GHMC anti-de Sitter structures
status_evidence.snippet: Introduces metrics on the deformation space of GHMC AdS structures; does not settle GH-standard deformation question.
status_evidence.claim: Active study of GHMC AdS deformation space without resolution of the GH-standard deformation question.

status_evidence.title: Wild globally hyperbolic maximal anti-de Sitter structures
status_evidence.snippet: Constructs wild GHMC AdS structures parameterized by crowned Teichmüller spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Continued exploration of GHMC AdS structures, leaving the GH-standard deformation question unaddressed.

status_evidence.title: Anti-de Sitter Geometry (PhD Thesis)
status_evidence.snippet: Surveys AdS geometry and GHMC structures.
status_evidence.claim: Survey-level treatment without claim of resolution.
